description: Libra zodiac sign: personality traits, strengths and challenges, love, career, decans and dates (September 23 to October 22).
answer: In Western astrology, Libra is the seventh sign of the zodiac, a cardinal air sign ruled by Venus. It is traditionally associated with fairness, charm, diplomacy and an eye for proportion. The Sun is in Libra from about September 23 to October 22. The exact dates shift by a day from year to year.

sections.heading: Libra personality traits
paragraphs: Libra is the only sign of the zodiac whose symbol is an object rather than a creature: a pair of scales, held level. That image explains a great deal. Libra is usually pictured as the person weighing both sides, noticing what is lopsided in a room, a conversation or an argument, and quietly trying to set it right. Astrologers describe the sign as sociable, courteous and keenly aware of how things look and feel to other people. Its interest in balance is not passive, though. Underneath the pleasant manners there is often a firm, almost legal sense of what is fair and what is not.

Libra is a cardinal air sign ruled by Venus. Air signs live in ideas, words and connection, so Libra tends to think out loud with others and to understand itself through relationships. Cardinal signs open a season, and this one marks the autumn equinox in the northern hemisphere, when day and night briefly match; the starter energy here goes into proposing, inviting and brokering rather than charging ahead alone. Venus adds taste, warmth and a liking for pleasure and beauty. Put together, Libra is often read as the zodiac's natural host and negotiator, someone who would rather build agreement than win by force.

sections.heading: Libra strengths and challenges
paragraphs: At its best Libra is the person who can sit between two angry friends and help each of them feel heard. It reads tone well, chooses words with care and tends to see the merit in a view it does not share, which makes it a gifted mediator and a generous listener. There is real aesthetic intelligence here too: Libra usually knows how to make a space, an outfit or an evening feel right. Add natural courtesy, a talent for partnership and a sincere commitment to justice, and you get someone who makes shared life smoother, kinder and more civilised for everyone nearby.

The same scales that weigh things fairly can swing for a long time before settling. Libra is famous for indecision, partly because it sees too many valid options and partly because choosing one may disappoint somebody. Avoiding friction can slide into people-pleasing, where its own preferences go unspoken until resentment leaks out sideways. Some Libras keep the peace on the surface while privately keeping score. There can also be a reliance on other people's approval to feel settled, and a tendency to tidy over a problem with charm instead of naming it. None of this is fixed; it is simply where the sign's gifts overreach.

sections.heading: Libra in love and relationships
paragraphs: Relationships are close to the centre of Libra's life, and many people with this Sun sign say they feel most like themselves when they are part of a pair. In love it tends to be attentive, romantic and thoughtful about the small rituals: the well-chosen gift, the table set properly, the remembered detail. Libra offers partnership in the full sense, a willingness to share decisions and to consider the other person's comfort as seriously as its own. It usually needs courtesy, conversation and a partner who treats the relationship as a joint project rather than a contest.

Friction often comes from what Libra does not say. Wanting harmony, it may agree in the moment and then feel quietly overruled, or it may stay too long in a connection that is pleasant but no longer honest. Partners can find it hard to tell what Libra actually wants. What helps is making disagreement feel safe: asking for its real preference and waiting for the answer, treating a difference of opinion as normal rather than a threat, and keeping beauty and fun in the routine. Libra in turn does well to practise saying a plain no while the issue is still small.

sections.heading: Libra at work
paragraphs: Libra tends to work best with other people rather than in isolation. It brings tact, a feel for presentation and a talent for seeing how a decision will land with different groups. That suits roles in law, mediation, human resources, diplomacy, design, styling, events, client relations and anywhere a team needs someone who can translate between departments. As a leader Libra is usually consultative, gathering views before acting and keeping morale high. Colleagues often trust it because it is visibly trying to be fair, even when the outcome does not go their way.

The pitfall at work is the slow decision. Libra can circle a choice, asking for one more opinion, until the moment has passed or someone less careful decides instead. It may also avoid giving hard feedback, which leaves problems to grow. With money, the Venus side enjoys quality and comfort, so spending on beautiful things or on generous hospitality can creep up unnoticed. Simple guardrails help: a deadline for every decision, a short list of non-negotiables, and a habit of checking costs before the pleasant part of shopping begins.

sections.heading: Growth and the three Libra decans
paragraphs: Libra's main growth edge is learning that balance includes its own needs. A fair outcome that leaves you silently unhappy is not really fair. A practical start is to notice how often you ask, "What do you think?" before you have checked what you think, and to answer that question privately first. Try small, low-stakes decisions on your own, such as choosing the restaurant or the film without polling anyone, to build the muscle. When conflict appears, remind yourself that a calm, honest disagreement often strengthens a bond more than smooth agreement does. Keep the gift for harmony, but let it rest on truth rather than on avoidance, and give your sense of justice a direction outside yourself.

Libra divides into three decans of ten degrees each. The first, roughly September 23 to October 2, belongs to Venus; the second, about October 3 to October 12, to Uranus; and the third, around October 13 to October 22, to Mercury. Each has its own page, and every Libra birthday links to its decan.

faq.question: Why is Libra so indecisive?
faq.answer: Libra is traditionally linked with weighing and comparing, so it often sees good arguments on several sides at once. It also tends to dislike letting anyone down. The result can be a long pause before choosing. Setting time limits and clarifying personal priorities first usually makes decisions much easier.

faq.question: Who is Libra most compatible with?
faq.answer: Libra is usually said to click with the other air signs, Gemini and Aquarius, which share its love of conversation and ideas. Fire signs, especially Leo and Sagittarius, are often described as lively partners. Its opposite, Aries, brings a strong attraction and a useful lesson in directness. Individual charts matter more than Sun signs alone.

faq.question: What are the dates for Libra?
faq.answer: About September 23 to October 22. The Sun's entry into each sign moves by a day or so between years, so birthdays at either end are cusp dates; the zodiac sign calculator settles them for a specific year.

faq.question: What are the three Libra decans?
faq.answer: The first decan (0° to 9°) is linked with Venus, the second (10° to 19°) with Uranus and the third (20° to 29°) with Mercury, following the rulers of the air signs in zodiac order.
